tokens.name: brand-blue
tokens.usage: Vincons navy. Primary actions, active states, headings that carry the brand, focus ring. White text on it passes 10:1.

tokens.name: brand-blue-hover
tokens.usage: Hover / pressed state of brand-blue fills.

tokens.name: brand-blue-soft
tokens.usage: Selected rows, active tab ground, info callouts. Text on it: brand-blue.

tokens.name: brand-blue-line
tokens.usage: Border of brand-blue-soft surfaces and selected inputs.

tokens.name: brand-maroon
tokens.usage: Vingroup maroon. Secondary brand accent: avatar ground, chart second series, card print header. Never for errors.

tokens.name: brand-red
tokens.usage: Vingroup red. Notification dot and destructive solid buttons (white text 4.7:1). Text on white only at 14px bold or larger.

tokens.name: brand-yellow
tokens.usage: Vingroup yellow. Only on sidebar/navy grounds: active nav marker, overline. Never on white (1.2:1).

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: App background behind cards and tables.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, dialogs, header bar, inputs.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Table header row, toolbar strips, read-only fields.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Default 1px border of cards, tables, dividers.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input, select and checkbox outlines (3.2:1 against surface). Hover: ink-muted; focus: brand-blue + 3px brand-blue-line ring.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and numbers.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: table cells, labels.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Captions, helper text, timestamps. Passes 5.6:1 on surface, 5.2:1 on canvas. Replaces gray-400/gray-500.

tokens.name: ink-placeholder
tokens.usage: Input placeholders and disabled labels, on surface only (4.6:1).

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: Sidebar ground (solid; replaces the blue→maroon gradient).

tokens.name: sidebar-hover
tokens.usage: Sidebar item hover.

tokens.name: sidebar-active
tokens.usage: Sidebar active item ground, paired with a brand-yellow 3px marker.

tokens.name: sidebar-ink
tokens.usage: Sidebar active and hovered labels.

tokens.name: sidebar-ink-muted
tokens.usage: Sidebar idle labels and icons (7.6:1 on sidebar).

tokens.name: sidebar-line
tokens.usage: Dividers inside the sidebar.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Complete records, active cards. Text/icon on success-soft.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Success badge and callout ground.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Expiring within 30 days. Text/icon on warning-soft.

tokens.name: warning-solid
tokens.usage: Warning icon on surface, chart series for 'expiring'.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Warning badge and callout ground.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, expired, missing documents. Text/icon on danger-soft or surface.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Danger badge, error field ground.

tokens.name: neutral-soft
tokens.usage: Neutral badge ground (draft, inactive). Text: ink-2.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: One per page, top-left of the content area. Color ink.

styles.usage: Names, primary cell in a row, button labels.

styles.usage: Secondary line under a name, helper text.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Uppercase labels: table headers, sidebar group labels.
